description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for message-related resources in a gateway service, including methods to retrieve default and maximum timeout durations, and includes an enumeration of configuration path expressions with default values.

classes.name: MessageConfig
classes.description: An interface that provides methods to retrieve message timeout configurations.

classes.name: MessageConfigMessageConfigValue
classes.description: An enumeration implementing KnownConfigValue that defines known configuration paths and their default values for message configurations.

methods.name: getDefaultTimeout
methods.description: Returns the default timeout duration for claim messages initiated via /messages resource.

methods.name: getMaxTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum timeout duration for claim messages.
